oracle: photutils 2.0.2 with astropy 6.1.7, numpy 2.2.6 and scipy 1.15.3
identity: Independent, cited implementations; no Gravitas code ran: photutils.background.Background2D (MedianBackground, StdBackgroundRMS), astropy.stats.SigmaClip, astropy.convolution (Gaussian2DKernel, convolve), photutils.segmentation (detect_sources, SourceCatalog), photutils.psf (fit_fwhm, CircularGaussianPRF, MoffatPSF), scipy.interpolate.RegularGridInterpolator, scipy.optimize.least_squares.
index: https://pypi.org/simple (pip default index; no mirror, no pip.conf, no PIP_* variable); the virtual environment is Prompt 180's, in which nothing was added for this prompt
install: python3.10 -m venv <scratchpad>/oracle180; <venv>/bin/python -m pip install --only-binary :all: numpy scipy astropy photutils (the resolved versions above); the venv is not committed and no package is
run: cd <empty scratchpad directory>; <venv>/bin/python -I tools/detection-oracle/oracle.py tests/fixtures/detection/oracle-inputs.json tests/fixtures/detection/oracle-results.json; then Prettier
inputsFrom: node tools/detection-oracle/make-inputs.mjs (tools/detection-synth.mjs: detector-kernel frames of fixed seeds, whole ADU), then Prettier
revisions: 1: the oracle's first run, before js/measure/detect.js existed, showed two flaws in the committed algorithm (a constant background beyond the outer box centres; one global sum of squares for the smoothed noise); thresholds.json and DETECTION.md record both corrections, a74b4357

2: oracle.py gained fwhmTight (the Gaussian fit again by scipy least_squares at tolerances of 1e-15) after the first comparison showed photutils.psf.fit_fwhm converges only to about 1e-4; every earlier number is unchanged and the inputs are the same bytes

parameters.mesh: Background2D(box_size=16, filter_size=1, exclude_percentile=100, mask, SigmaClip(sigma=3, maxiters=10, cenfunc=median, stdfunc=std), MedianBackground(sigma_clip=None), StdBackgroundRMS(sigma_clip=None)); maps by RegularGridInterpolator(linear, bounds_error=False, fill_value=None) at pixel positions, i.e. the first and last interval continued; the noise floored at half the smallest box value
parameters.smoothing: Gaussian2DKernel(x_stddev=FWHM/2.3548, size 2 ceil(3 sigma) + 1, mode center, sum 1); the smoothed image as matrices of the weights as they land (repeated edge pixel, masked pixel removed, renormalised), agreeing with astropy convolve(boundary='extend', nan_treatment='interpolate') to 1e-12 (convolveAgreement in the results); the smoothed noise sqrt(sum w^2 sigma^2)
parameters.segmentation: detect_sources(smoothed, 4 x smoothed noise, npixels=5, connectivity=8, mask)
parameters.catalog: SourceCatalog(background-subtracted unsmoothed electrons, segmentation, mask); area, xcentroid, ycentroid, semimajor_sigma, semiminor_sigma, orientation, ellipticity, fwhm, max_value, segment_flux
parameters.gaussian: photutils.psf.fit_fwhm(xypos=catalog centroid, fwhm=catalog fwhm, fit_shape=(2R+1, 2R+1)), R = ceil(2.5 max(FWHM0, 2.5)), unweighted, background subtracted and held at zero; fwhmTight: least_squares(trf, bounds, x_scale=jac, tolerances 1e-15) over CircularGaussianPRF
parameters.moffat: least_squares(trf, bounds on fwhm and beta, x_scale=jac, tolerances 1e-15) over MoffatPSF, each pixel the mean of 5 by 5 sub-pixel midpoints, unweighted, start beta 3

selection: a fit is made for a source with segment flux of at least 2000 electrons, its square of 2R+1 pixels inside the frame, no other source centroid within R+3 pixels, in frames with no mask
conventions: pixel (0, 0) is the centre of the first pixel; electrons are bias-subtracted ADU times the gain 1.5
references: Bradley, L. et al., photutils (Zenodo release 2.0.2)
Harris, C. R. et al. 2020, Nature 585, 357 (numpy)
Virtanen, P. et al. 2020, Nature Methods 17, 261 (scipy)
Bertin, E. and Arnouts, S. 1996, A&AS 117, 393 (SExtractor: the segment moments and the 1/12 rule)
